description: Parse a raw multipart/form-data request body into its individual parts: field name, filename (for file fields), headers, and decoded value, per RFC 7578. Give the boundary directly, or the request's Content-Type header value to extract it from automatically.

boundary.description: The multipart boundary (without the leading --), if known directly

contentType.description: Alternative to boundary: the request's Content-Type header value, from which the boundary is extracted

name: parse_multipart_form_data
